Sandbox_KnoxSystem_PowerDamagePercentPer: Bonus Damage per level of Power
Each Power level adds this percent of hit damage as bonus (weapons only). Min 1, Max 100, Default 10.
Sandbox_KnoxSystem_PowerKnockPointsPerLe: Knockdown Chance per level of Power
Flat points added to the knockdown roll: knockChance = (this x Power) + (0.4 x Strength). Min 0, Max 10, Default 2.
Sandbox_KnoxSystem_EnduranceStaminaPerce: Stamina Efficiency per level of Endurance
Refund this % of each stamina loss per Endurance level, and add this % extra on each stamina gain. Min 1, Max 20, Default 6 (L10 = 60%).
Sandbox_KnoxSystem_EnduranceEncumbranceD: Over-Encumbrance Damage Resist per level of Endurance
When over weight (or Heavy Load moodle), refund this % of incoming damage per Endurance level. Separate from stamina efficiency. Min 0, Max 20, Default 6 (L10 = 60%).
Sandbox_KnoxSystem_SpCostPower: SP Cost per level of Power
Sandbox_KnoxSystem_SpCostPower_tooltip: Skill points required to buy one Power level on the System tab. Min 1, Max 5, Default 2.
Sandbox_KnoxSystem_SpCostEndurance: SP Cost per level of Endurance
Sandbox_KnoxSystem_SpCostEndurance_toolt: Skill points required to buy one Endurance level on the System tab. Min 1, Max 5, Default 2.
Sandbox_KnoxSystem_PersonalXpPercent_too: Scales Personal XP minted from vanilla/base skill XP. 100 = full weight tables. Min 50, Max 500, Default 100.
Sandbox_KnoxSystem_ClassSkillPersonalXpP: Scales Personal XP minted from class skill XP (Melee, Armored, Charge, etc.). 100 = 1 Personal XP per 1 class skill XP. Default 50 = old half-bucket rate. Min 10, Max 200, Default 50.
Sandbox_KnoxSystem_AllowSprintersIfVanil: Allow Knox Sprinters if Vanilla Sprinters Off

If checked, Knox world tiers may still stamp sprinter walk types when sandbox zombie speed has no sprinters. If unchecked, Knox never forces sprinters unless vanilla already allows them. Default: Yes.
Sandbox_KnoxSystem_GoblinChancePerThousa: Chance a newly stamped zombie is a Goblin (exclusive: no Elite Rank, no other Modifiers). Value is per thousand: 1 = 0.1% (1/1000), 2 = 0.2% (1/500, default), 10 = 1% (1/100). Min 1, Max 10, Default 2.
